entries.final: Export dokončený: %1$s. Celá vaša kresba stále obsahuje neuložené zmeny; pred jej nahradením uložte kópiu celého obrázka.
entries.reason: Export dokončený is a grammatical label-style completion announcement without imposing agreement on %1$s. Celá vaša kresba with neuložené zmeny explicitly retains the whole drawing and unsaved changes after export; pred jej nahradením + uložte requires saving the complete-image copy before replacing that feminine kresba.
Uložiť is the standard infinitive menu command; ako introduces the output designation without changing %1$s.
The infinitive command Uložiť ako is grammatical with the unchanged format name JPEG; the single U+2026 marks a continuing action.
Uložiť ako correctly introduces the complete format name JPEG XL, not two separate choices; one U+2026 remains.
Uložiť ako correctly introduces PNG; format spelling and the single U+2026 remain unchanged.

Popredie and pozadie correctly name foreground/background. Paleta farieb uses the correct genitive plural farieb. Colon-separated labels preserve each slot without requiring %3$s to agree adjectivally or assuming it means Main; a state or action can follow the label.

entries.final: Režim zmeny mierky dvoma prstami a posúvania
entries.reason: Režim governs the coordinated genitives zmeny and posúvania; mierky specifies scaling and dvoma prstami is correct instrumental for two fingers. This denotes two-finger zoom and panning rather than a paint tool.

entries.final: Izvoz končan: %1$s. Vaša celotna risba še vedno vsebuje neshranjene spremembe; preden jo zamenjate, shranite kopijo celotne slike.
entries.reason: Izvoz končan is grammatical compressed UI wording agreeing with masculine izvoz, not unknown %1$s. Celotna risba and neshranjene spremembe retain the whole drawing and still-unsaved changes. Preden jo zamenjate requires shranite kopijo celotne slike first, with feminine jo referring to risba.
Shrani is a grammatical singular imperative menu command and kot introduces the unchanged %1$s designation.
Shrani kot is the correct imperative Save-as construction; JPEG stays intact and one U+2026 remains.
Shrani kot correctly treats JPEG XL as one format designation; its internal space and single U+2026 are retained.
Shrani kot correctly introduces PNG; the single U+2026 preserves the continuing-action cue.

Ospredje/ozadje correctly contrast foreground/background; barvna agrees with feminine paleta. Colons separate labels from their values, so %3$s need not be an adjective and can name a state or action without an invented Main.

entries.final: Način spreminjanja povečave z dvema prstoma in premikanja pogleda
entries.reason: Način governs coordinated genitives spreminjanja and premikanja; povečave specifies zoom and pogleda makes movement of the view explicit. Z dvema prstoma correctly uses Slovenian instrumental dual, preserving the two-finger gesture rather than drawing.

entries.final: S’ha exportat %1$s. El dibuix complet encara té canvis sense desar; desa una còpia de la imatge completa abans de substituir-lo.
entries.reason: S’ha exportat reports export, not full-drawing saving. El dibuix complet encara té canvis sense desar explicitly retains the full drawing and still-unsaved changes. Desa una còpia de la imatge completa abans de substituir-lo imposes the save-before-replace order; masculine -lo refers to dibuix, not feminine còpia/imatge.
Anomena i desa preserves the accepted paired imperative command; com a introduces the output designation and %1$s is unchanged.

entries.final: Primer pla: %1$s, fons: %2$s. Paleta de colors: %3$s.
entries.reason: Primer pla and fons correctly name foreground/background; paleta de colors is natural Catalan noun-phrase composition. Colons attach all three slots without adjective agreement or inventing Main; %3$s may supply a state or action.

entries.final: Mode de gest de pinça i desplaçament
entries.reason: Mode de governs the coordinated concepts gest de pinça and desplaçament. Gest de pinça denotes the pinch gesture (not a physical clamp tool here), and desplaçament denotes panning. Repeating de before the second coordinated noun is not required.
